title: MONSTER CFB Game Total Page 1 Compact Layout V1
problem: CFB Game Total Page 1 is vertically overloaded on mobile because deep analysis steps are forced open and mobile team comparison layouts collapse to single-column towers.
root_cause: Presentation defaults, not data/model logic: Steps 1-3 emit open details and narrow-screen CSS collapses verified two-team evidence to one card per row.
patch: Add one Page-1-only presentation wrapper above V45 that converts analysis details into an exclusive compact accordion and overrides narrow-screen identity/team-evidence layout while preserving all analytics and Page 2.
acceptance: Analysis steps no longer all render expanded by default
Analysis details share one exclusive accordion group
Mobile identity comparison stays side-by-side instead of becoming a tall single-column tower
Mobile Team Evidence stays side-by-side instead of becoming a tall single-column tower
Page 2 remains on frozen V45 owner
No model, projection, probability, ranking, selection, provider, market-owner, sportsbook, or other-sport changes
